_: H1 (7 Oct 2026): the bench caller's accents. Every voice was picked from GET /voices?language=en (450 voices) and ?language=zh on Cartesia account C on 7 Oct 2026, by its 'accents' field (accent, locale, is_native) and its description. 'native' = the accent the voice is listed as native in. Voices whose native language is not English speak English through sonic-3.6 with language 'en'; whether their accent carries into English is NOT proven (bench/hear.mjs and a listen will say). bench/run.mjs --accent <key> and bench/hear.mjs read this file.
